app.name: VitaForge
app.tagline: A personal training plan with safety first
notice.experimental: Development preview: data and exercises are samples and have not been expert-reviewed. Not medical advice.
notice.notMedical: This app is not medical advice and does not replace consulting a professional.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters with an uppercase letter and a digit.
auth.adultsOnly: This app is for adults (18+) only.
auth.login.title: Log in
auth.register.title: Create an account
auth.register.have: Already have an account? Log in
auth.register.done: Account created. We sent a 6-digit verification code to your email. Enter it on the next step.
auth.verify.title: Verify email
auth.verify.done: Email verified. You can log in now.
error.validation_failed: The information entered is not valid.
error.auth_failed: The email or password is wrong, or the account is not verified yet.
error.account_locked: The account is temporarily locked; try again later.
error.conflict: This request conflicts with the current state.
error.not_found: The requested item was not found.
error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
error.quota_or_plan_required: Your current plan does not include this feature.
error.needs_content: There are not yet enough reviewed exercises for your equipment and restrictions.
error.feature_unavailable: This feature is not available yet.
error.gone: This code or link has expired.
error.consent_required: Valid consent for health-data processing is required.
error.csrf_failed: Your session has expired; refresh the page and log in again.
onb.title: Onboarding
onb.equipment.hint: If you select nothing, only bodyweight exercises are considered.
consent.title: Consent to health-data processing
consent.accept: I consent to my health data being processed to build a safe plan.
consent.mustAccept: A plan cannot be built without this consent.
consent.noDoc: The consent document is not available.
screening.title: Initial warning-sign screening
screening.intro: These questions are for your safety only and are not a medical diagnosis. If any answer is “Yes”, no plan will be built and you will be advised to consult a professional.
screening.q.chest_pain: Chest pain during activity or at rest
screening.q.severe_unexplained_pain: Severe pain with no clear cause
screening.q.neurological_symptoms: Neurological symptoms (e.g. sudden numbness or weakness)
onb.finish.title: You are ready
onb.finish.body: Your information is saved. Continue to build your plan.
plan.title: Training plan
plan.empty: No plan has been built yet.
plan.modified: This plan was limited or adjusted based on your safety information.
decision.NEEDS_INFO.title: More information is needed
decision.NEEDS_INFO.body: To build a safe plan, first answer the questions below.
decision.STOP_AND_REFER.title: No plan was built
decision.STOP_AND_REFER.body: Based on your answers, please consult a doctor or professional before exercising.
decision.BLOCK_OUT_OF_SCOPE.title: Outside this app's scope
decision.BLOCK_OUT_OF_SCOPE.body: Your recorded situation is outside this app's scope; consult a professional.
decision.BLOCK_CONSENT.title: Consent is required
decision.BLOCK_CONSENT.body: No plan is built without valid consent to health-data processing.
decision.ERROR_FAILSAFE.title: No plan was built, for safety
decision.ERROR_FAILSAFE.body: An error occurred during the safety check, so no plan was built as a precaution. Try again later.
decision.blocked.title: No plan was built
decision.blocked.body: The safety check did not allow a plan to be built.
decision.referral.unreviewed: The text of this referral has not been expert-reviewed yet.
session.expired: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
consent.draftNotice: This text is a draft that has not been legally reviewed; it is not valid for real use.
plan.noUnreviewed: No unapproved exercise is ever shown in a plan.
error.phone_registration_not_supported: Sign-up with a phone number is not supported yet.
error.under_18: This app is for ages 18 and over.
decision.RESTRICT.title: No valid exercise remains
decision.RESTRICT.body: Given your safety information and equipment, no approved exercise remains to build a plan. No plan was built; consult a professional if needed.
plan.experimental.title: Experimental content — not reviewed
plan.experimental.body: The exercises in this plan come from development sample data: the texts have not been expert-reviewed and carry no medical or scientific approval. For development display only; do not use for real training.
onb.priority.hint: A preference only; it never overrides safety limits.
ex.title: Exercise details
ex.unreviewed: This description has not been expert-reviewed and is for display only.
nut.title: Weekly meal plan
nut.intro: General-wellness estimates and meal plans; not medical advice or a therapeutic diet.
nut.profile.title: Nutrition details
nut.screen.title: Nutrition safety questions
nut.screen.eating_disorder_risk: History of, or concern about, an eating disorder
nut.screen.medical_diet_needed: A prescribed diet, or a condition that requires a special diet
nut.estimate.title: Energy and macronutrient estimate
nut.estimate.goalNote: Weight-loss/gain targets have not been expert-reviewed; only a maintenance estimate is given.
nut.refer.title: No meal plan will be built
nut.refer.body: Based on your answers, please consult a doctor or dietitian about nutrition. This app does not produce therapeutic diets.
nut.blocked.body: The safety check did not allow an estimate. Please complete onboarding and consent first.
nut.needsinfo.body: More information is needed for an estimate.
nut.prefs.title: Preferences and restrictions
nut.allergens.hint: If a food's allergen status is unknown, recipes using it are not used.
nut.budget.hint: Checked only against recorded fresh prices; prices are never guessed.
nut.content.title: Verified food content is not available yet
nut.content.body: A meal plan needs verified food data and recipes, and none exist yet. For that reason no meal plan is built or shown. The energy estimate above remains valid.
nut.empty: No meal plan has been built yet.
nut.meal.noSteps: No preparation steps are recorded for this meal.
nut.meal.allergensUnknown: Allergen status of some ingredients is unknown
nut.meal.missing: Some nutrient values were missing in the source; totals are lower bounds.
nut.budget.met: Within budget (based on recorded fresh prices)
nut.budget.exceeded: Over budget; even the cheapest valid options were not enough
nut.budget.unverifiable: Budget cannot be verified: some ingredients have no fresh price
nut.shop.title: Shopping list for the week
nut.unreviewed.title: Unreviewed food content
nut.unreviewed.body: Foods or recipes have not been expert-reviewed and are for development display only; do not use them for real nutrition decisions.
nut.consent.needed: You must complete consent to health-data processing to use nutrition.
nut.reason.NUT-NO-RECIPE: No suitable reviewed recipe exists for the “{slot}” slot.
nut.reason.NUT-PRICE-MISSING: Some ingredients have no fresh price.
nut.reason.NUT-R03:goal-targets-disabled: Numeric weight-loss/gain targets are disabled pending expert review.
nut.reason.NUT-PROTEIN-OUTSIDE-RANGE-SOM: Protein falls outside the estimated range on some days.
nut.reason.NUT-R04: Referral to a professional (medical diet / pregnancy / breastfeeding).
nut.reason.NUT-OUT-OF-RANGE-GUARD: Outside the safe range of this estimate; consult a professional.
nut.reason.NUT-ESTIMATE: Estimate based on a general formula.
auth.verify.sent: If this address has an unverified account, a new code was sent. The previous code no longer works.
auth.verify.resendWait: You can request a new code in {seconds} s.
auth.verify.expiredHint: The code expired or was used up. Request a new one.
auth.verify.checkInbox: Check your inbox (and spam folder). Codes are valid for 30 minutes.
auth.forgot.title: Reset password
auth.forgot.done: If an account exists for this address, we sent a reset link. It is valid for 30 minutes and works once.
auth.reset.title: Choose a new password
auth.reset.missing: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.
auth.reset.done: Password changed. You can log in now.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
lib.title: Exercise library
lib.empty: No exercises match. Only reviewed or clearly labelled experimental exercises are listed.
lib.noneAtAll: The exercise library has no published exercises yet. Content is added only after expert review.
plan.substituted: The exercise was replaced with a safe alternative.
error.no_valid_alternative: No safe alternative is available for this exercise right now.
wk.title: Workout
wk.pain: I am stopping because of pain or an unusual symptom
wk.painWarn: Stopping for pain or an unusual symptom is the right call. Do not train through it.
wk.noDay: Choose a day from your plan first.
wk.dayMissing: This day was not found in your current plan.
wk.field.load: Enter a load from 0 to 1000 kg.
hist.title: Workout history
dash.title: Dashboard
foods.title: Foods & recipes
foods.intro: Browse nutrition data. Entries are labeled: reviewed data is shown as reviewed; anything else is clearly marked unreviewed and is not medical or dietary advice.
foods.avoiding: Hiding items containing your saved allergens: {list}
foods.empty.title: No data yet.
foods.empty.body: No reviewed food or recipe data is available. Nothing is invented; entries appear here only after they are imported and reviewed.
foods.noNutrients: No nutrient values are recorded for this entry.
nut.profile.allergens.hint: Saved allergens hide matching items and trigger alerts when you log a meal. Missing allergen data is never treated as safe.
nut.log.title: Daily log
nut.log.manual.hint: Values you enter are stored as user-entered, not as verified data.
nut.log.name: Name
nut.log.unavailable: Daily logging needs a completed nutrition profile with an eligible result.
nut.log.allergenUnknown: Allergen data for this item is incomplete; it cannot be confirmed safe.
shop.priceInvalid: Enter a positive price, a 3-letter currency and a region above.
prog.title: Progression suggestions
prog.hint: Suggestions only. You decide; pain or a safety lock always takes priority.
profile.title: Profile
profile.consents.hint: Health-data consent is required for nutrition and safety features. You can withdraw it at any time.
profile.delete.title: Delete account
profile.delete.body: This permanently erases your account and health data. It cannot be undone.
hist.trend.hint: Last 8 weeks, from your own logged sessions. Empty weeks mean nothing was logged.
nut.log.week.hint: Estimated from what you logged; unlogged days appear empty, not as zero intake.
profile.export.hint: The file is available for 24 hours, only to you. It contains your health data: store it safely.
profile.export.expired: This export has expired. Request a new one.
